entwurf.beschreibung: A snappy walkthrough of MoneyPrinterTurbo, showing how a single keyword becomes a ready‑to‑post short, with honest limits on API keys and stock footage.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: MoneyPrinterTurbo turns a keyword into a ready‑to‑post 9:16 short video automatically, instantly.
teile.szene: A bright studio with a quirky presenter holding a coffee mug, gesturing at a floating keyword bubble that reads "summer travel". Neon‑pink lighting, urban‑poster vibe, central vertical crop.

teile.name: Problem
teile.text: It writes a full script, pulls free HD footage from Pexels, and stitches clips into a seamless timeline.
teile.szene: A frustrated creator scrolling endless stock sites, eyes glazed, while a cheap robot voice blares from a laptop. Dim desk lamp, late‑night vibe, central crop.

teile.name: Tool Intro
teile.text: You can choose Edge TTS for a clear, natural voiceover, or upload your own audio file in seconds.
teile.szene: Animated UI showing a keyword input, then rapid checkmarks for script, footage, voiceover. Vibrant colors, cartoon‑style, central focus.

teile.name: Step 1
teile.text: Export options include 1080×1920 portrait, 1920×1080 landscape, or 1080×1080 square, all in HD with crisp audio.
teile.szene: A terminal window typing `mpt generate "summer travel"`, with a tiny lock icon popping up. Retro green‑on‑black, central frame.

teile.name: Step 2
teile.text: The tool runs on Windows 10+, macOS 11+, or mainstream Linux with Python 3.11, and optional GPU acceleration improves batch speed significantly.
teile.szene: Footage thumbnails sliding into a timeline, each clip snapping into place. Soft studio lighting, central vertical crop.

teile.name: Step 3
teile.text: MoneyPrinterTurbo lets you publish finished videos directly to TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube Shorts, handling encoding and upload.
teile.szene: Waveform visualizing speech, with a subtitle box appearing underneath. Warm amber light, central focus.

teile.name: CTA
teile.text: Give it a try, share this guide, and save it for future projects.
teile.szene: Presenter gives a thumbs‑up, background flashes the exported 9:16 thumbnail. Neon‑green glow, central vertical crop.
